input.quote: 19.2 For ninety days after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation and acceptance criteria. Hosted Services will conform throughout the subscription term. Vendor warrants it has authority to enter the Agreement and grant the rights stated here.
input.rationale: Section 19 meets the preferred position. Vendor warrants Services are performed in a professional and workmanlike manner by qualified personnel to industry standards (19.1); Deliverables materially conform to documentation and acceptance criteria for ninety days after delivery or acceptance, and hosted Services conform throughout the subscription term (19.2) — the hosted-software warranty runs longer than the preferred 12 months; and 19.3 adds no-malicious-code and Applicable Law compliance warranties. The remedy in 19.4 is prompt re-performance, repair or replacement at no charge, with termination plus refund of Fees paid if Vendor cannot cure, and it is expressly non-exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims. The disclaimer in 19.5 is limited to implied warranties and expressly does not limit any express warranty, service level, indemnity or remedy, so it does not swallow the express warranty. No redline needed.
